knowledge:
- key_parameters: in_gtf=Input GTF file defining genomic coordinates of existing genes, required to have a gene_id attribute in the ninth column ;; in_bamv=A vector of input BAM files containing RNA-seq alignments, which must be strand-specific paired-end ('fr-firststrand') ;; method=Prediction method keyword (e.g., 'plcf', 'plst', 'cfmg', 'cftc', 'stmg', 'cf', 'st') ;; genome=Genome name for defining chromosome sizes in defIgRanges() ('hg19', 'hg38', 'mm9', 'mm10') ;; radius=Distance threshold (default 10 kb) away from known genes to define intergenic ranges ;; min_n_exon=Minimum number of exons (default 2) for selecting transcript models in selModel() ;; min_tr_len=Minimum total length of exons and introns (default 200 bp) for selecting transcript models in selModel()
- alternatives: Supports seven transcript prediction methods: pooling alignments then building with Cufflinks ('plcf') or StringTie ('plst'); building individually then merging with Cuffmerge ('cfmg'), TACO ('cftc'), or StringTie-merge ('stmg'); or predicting from a single dataset using Cufflinks ('cf') or StringTie ('st').
- when_to_use: Use when you have strand-specific paired-end RNA-seq datasets and want to define, predict, filter, and evaluate novel transcript models specifically within intergenic regions.
- pitfalls: Only supports strand-specific paired-end RNA-seq data with the 'fr-firststrand' protocol ;; Input GTF files must have a 'gene_id' attribute in the ninth column for defIgRanges() and a 'transcript_id' attribute for selModel() ;; Requires external command-line tools (Cufflinks, StringTie, or TACO) which must be installed or allowed to auto-download ;; On macOS, pre-compiled Cufflinks versions 2.2.1 and 2.2.0 have issues processing BAM files, so version 2.1.1 is recommended.

workflows.name: convenient_wrapper_runpram
workflows.intent: Predict intergenic transcript models from gene annotations and RNA-seq alignments using the convenient wrapper function runPRAM.
input: in.gtf (GTF file of existing gene annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Define input files and output path ;; 2. Run the wrapper function runPRAM to predict transcript models.
workflows.code:
in_gtf = system.file('extdata/demo/in.gtf', package='pram')

in_bamv = c(system.file('extdata/demo/SZP.bam', package='pram'),
            system.file('extdata/demo/TLC.bam', package='pram') )

pred_out_gtf = tempfile(fileext='.gtf')

##
## assuming the stringtie binary is in folder /usr/local/stringtie-1.3.3/
##
pram::runPRAM(  in_gtf, in_bamv, pred_out_gtf, method='plst',
                stringtie='/usr/loca/stringtie-1.3.3/stringtie')

workflows.name: step_by_step_pram_workflow
workflows.intent: Predict, select, and evaluate intergenic transcript models using the step-by-step PRAM workflow.
input: defIgRanges_in.gtf (GTF file of existing gene annotations)
selModel_in.gtf (GTF file containing predicted transcript models to be selected)
plcf.tsv (TSV file containing genomic coordinates of predicted model exons)
tgt.tsv (TSV file containing genomic coordinates of real target exons)
workflows.stages: 1. Define intergenic genomic ranges using defIgRanges() ;; 2. Extract intergenic RNA-seq alignments using prepIgBam() ;; 3. Build transcript models using buildModel() ;; 4. Select transcript models based on genomic features using selModel() ;; 5. Evaluate predicted models against true targets using evalModel().
workflows.code:
pram::defIgRanges(system.file('extdata/gtf/defIgRanges_in.gtf', package='pram'),
                genome = 'hg38')

finbam =system.file('extdata/bam/CMPRep2.sortedByCoord.raw.bam', 
                    package='pram')

iggrs = GenomicRanges::GRanges('chr10:77236000-77247000:+')

foutbam = tempfile(fileext='.bam')

pram::prepIgBam(finbam, iggrs, foutbam)

fbams = c(  system.file('extdata/bam/CMPRep1.sortedByCoord.clean.bam',
                        package='pram'),
            system.file('extdata/bam/CMPRep2.sortedByCoord.clean.bam',
                        package='pram') )

foutgtf = tempfile(fileext='.gtf')

##
## assuming the stringtie binary is in folder /usr/local/stringtie-1.3.3/
##
pram::buildModel(fbams, foutgtf, method='plst',
                stringtie='/usr/loca/stringtie-1.3.3/stringtie')

fin_gtf = system.file('extdata/gtf/selModel_in.gtf', package='pram')

fout_gtf = tempfile(fileext='.gtf')

pram::selModel(fin_gtf, fout_gtf)

fmdl = system.file('extdata/benchmark/plcf.tsv', package='pram')
ftgt = system.file('extdata/benchmark/tgt.tsv',  package='pram')

mdldt = data.table::fread(fmdl, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
tgtdt = data.table::fread(ftgt, header=TRUE, sep="\t")

pram::evalModel(mdldt, tgtdt)
